Why count characters?
Character counts matter for social media limits, SEO metadata, SMS messages, form fields, and writing constraints.
What is a character?
A character is any symbol: letters (A-Z, a-z), numbers (0-9), spaces, punctuation, and special characters.
Does space count as a character?
Yes. Spaces between words count as individual characters.
Why do social media platforms have limits?
Limits encourage concise communication and are based on historical technical constraints and user experience.
What is Twitter's character limit?
Twitter allows 280 characters per tweet (increased from 140 in 2017).
What is Instagram's character limit?
Instagram allows up to 2,200 characters in captions and 150 characters in bio.
What is the LinkedIn headline character limit?
LinkedIn headline has a 120 character limit for profile headlines.
What is the optimal meta description length?
Meta descriptions should be 150-160 characters to display fully in Google search results.
What is the optimal title tag length?
Title tags should be 50-60 characters to display fully in search results (desktop).
How do I count words vs. characters?
Words are typically space-separated; characters include all symbols. Character count is always higher.
Why is character counting important in SEO?
Proper character counts ensure metadata displays correctly in search results and improves click-through rates.
What if my character count is too long?
Edit for brevity, remove unnecessary words, or use abbreviations and symbols to fit within limits.
